verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because an email service with built-in AI features could offer a training opt-out. However, no first-party evidence documents any control that prevents user data from being used to train AI models. Community reports describe only turning off AI features and Smart Features settings, which is an adjacent control and not a training-data exclusion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
